corrections.claim: Displayed decimal precision accurately locates every supplied L-zero.
corrections.result: 352 of 654 displayed rounding cells exclude their intended root. The complete certified list and interval evaluations locate the error; nonzero residual at a decimal center alone is not the criterion.

corrections.claim: The original extended mod-7 scan provides every zero below height 220.
corrections.result: Three missing ordinates at indices 103, 128, 147. Exactly 157 zeros are certified in the full rectangle.

corrections.claim: A fixed absolute completed-function tolerance proves root-location accuracy.
corrections.result: At t=99.36, |Lambda| is about 1.20e-34 but |L| is about 0.1149. Strict positional brackets replace the stopping rule.

corrections.claim: Positive spectra of a complex character and its conjugate have equal real witness contributions.
corrections.result: Their first positive zeros differ. Conjugation reverses height. The historical full-Dedekind ratio based on doubling one positive list is withdrawn.

corrections.claim: The printed hardened-twist narrative is automatically supported by the current dataset.
corrections.result: Replace hardcoded numerical commentary with measured output and state that the heuristic floor is not a calibrated test. The character parity check is independent of zero data.
